findings: All 23 overlapping course views, both endpoint contexts and both source forks inspected.
The selected northern source alternatives follow the visible main river/shore margins; the rejected southern alternatives cross vegetated island edges.
Generalization crosses exposed bars and short shore margins. Source bridge line does not certify a safe bridge passage. Turkey Hole remains a take-out before the lower hazardous gorge.
